records.failureSummary: Reviewed the foundation slice against the requirement, architecture/technical specs and the slice acceptance criteria. AC-04 evidence is solid: server/store.js persists one JSON document under DATA_DIR (path.resolve of DATA_DIR, recursively created), writes via temp file plus fsync plus rename, and createUser() stores only a self-describing scrypt hash from server/password.js (fresh 16-byte salt, N=16384,r=8,p=1); store/password tests scan every file under DATA_DIR and find no plaintext password (5 named [AC-04] tests). AC-21 evidence is solid: GET / returns 200 text/html; charset=utf-8 from server/app.js and server/home-page.js contains exactly the four required data-testid hooks (home-title, task-list, search-input, new-task-button), covered by 5 named [AC-21] tests. Health endpoints /healthz, /health, /ready return 200 {\"status\":\"ok\"} from createDefaultRouter, and logging goes only to process.stdout/process.stderr with structural and textual redaction (password, token, authorization, secret, signing key), the request logger logs only the bounded pathname (never the query string), and the Dockerfile starts with exec-form CMD so no output redirection exists. Dockerfile review: FROM node:22-alpine, fixed non-root user taskboard UID/GID 10001, /data and /app chowned before VOLUME /data, USER taskboard before CMD, EXPOSE 3000, ENV DATA_DIR=/data. README documents install (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile), start (pnpm start), test (pnpm test), lint/typecheck/build, docker build -t taskboard ., docker run with -v taskboard-data:/data and -p 3000:3000, restart/persistence and non-root verification. No third-party runtime dependency: dependencies is {} and every server/test import is node: or relative (verified additionally by the pnpm lint/typecheck selfcheck per the QA gate). I re-ran pnpm test: 10/10 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped. However the review cannot approve: AC-30 (Must) requires at least one test whose name contains the AC number for every Must AC of this slice, and AC-01, AC-24, AC-25, AC-26 and AC-29 have no such test anywhere (grep for AC-01/AC-24/AC-25/AC-26/AC-29 finds only comments in server/app.js; server/scripts/selfcheck.mjs does not read Dockerfile or README at all). Additionally the AC-22 optional browser-render hook is absent and undocumented: no gated/skipped hook, no README note, no mention of AC-22 in any file. The required fix is confined to test files (AC-named contract tests plus a skipped browser hook), so this is a TEST follow-up rather than a product-code defect; the implementation itself meets AC-04, AC-21, the health endpoints, stdout logging, non-root container and README documentation.
